description:
Estimate the monthly payment on a home the way Zillow's mortgage calculator does: principal & interest, PMI, property tax, homeowners insurance and HOA, plus total interest and a yearly amortization schedule. Free and runs instantly.

Pass home_price, or property_id to use a saved Spur property's price (falls back to its Zestimate). Anything left out uses these defaults: 20% down, 30-year fixed, 6.25% rate, property tax 1.1% of price/yr, insurance 0.5% of price/yr, PMI 0.5% of the loan/yr when under 20% down (dropped at 78% loan-to-value). The default rate is a placeholder, not a live quote: tell the user which defaults were used and use their own rate when they give one.

down_payment.description: Down payment in USD (wins over down_payment_percent)

include_pmi.description: Force PMI on or off; by default it applies under 20% down

interest_rate.description: Annual interest rate in percent, e.g. 6.5

pmi_rate.description: PMI as % of the loan per year

property_id.description: Saved Spur property id; its price is used when home_price is omitted

property_tax_annual.description: Property tax per year, USD (wins over property_tax_rate)

property_tax_rate.description: Property tax as % of price per year

show_schedule.description: Include the year-by-year amortization table in the reply

name: spur_calculate_mortgage
title: Calculate mortgage payment
